changelog: v2: added kyverno-1.10 (eol 2024-08-01, endoflife.date/kyverno) -- a component the platform now runs that endoflife.date started tracking; no other entries changed.
note: endoflife.date-style feed: component -> eol date + a base unpatched-CVE annual rate at end of support. Consumed as a *time-varying* risk: to_fair_scenario.py ramps loss-event-frequency by how far `--as-of` sits past eol_date, so a policy version going unmaintained is priced like any other EOL risk, not a bespoke sunset.
